# References

## Data Sources

- World Trade Organization (2024). *Charts - World Trade in Agricultural Products*. WTO Secretariat estimates based on UN Comtrade data. [wto.org](https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/agric_e/ag_imp_exp_charts_e.htm#ag_products)

- Visual Capitalist (2026). *Ranked: The Countries That Feed the World*. [visualcapitalist.com](https://www.visualcapitalist.com/ranked-the-countries-that-feed-the-world/)

## Design & Accessibility References

- Garnier, S. (2024). *Viridis: Colorblind-Friendly Color Maps for R*. [sjmgarnier.github.io](https://sjmgarnier.github.io/viridis/)

- Okabe, M., & Ito, K. (2008). *Color Universal Design (CUD): How to make figures and presentations that are friendly to colorblind people*. JFLY, University of Cologne. [jfly.uni-koeln.de](https://jfly.uni-koeln.de/color/)

- Lüdecke, D., et al. (2024). *see: Visualisation Toolbox for easystats*. [easystats.github.io](https://easystats.github.io/see/)
